title: Fix webui display: correct script reference, add missing deps, fix billing data
body:
## Summary

Three errors prevent the webui from working:

1. **Server crashes on startup** — `routes/auth.js` requires `speakeasy` and `lib/mailer.js` requires `nodemailer`, but neither is in `package.json`. `server.js` eagerly loads all routes, so the `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` error crashes the process before any HTTP requests can be served.

2. **Wrong frontend loaded** — `index.html` loads `<script src="/app.js">` (642-line older version) instead of `/app2.js` (2239-line current SPA with tunnels, admin panel, account settings, 2FA, support, legal pages, etc.).

3. **`undefined tunnels` in billing UI** — `PRICES` in `billing.js` had `maxHosts` but no `maxTunnels`, so the dashboard pricing cards rendered `"undefined tunnels"`.

```diff
# package.json
+    "nodemailer": "^6.9.14",
+    "speakeasy": "^2.0.0",

# index.html
-  <script src="/app.js"></script>
+  <script src="/app2.js"></script>

# billing.js PRICES
-  monthly: { ..., maxHosts: 3 },
+  monthly: { ..., maxHosts: 3, maxTunnels: 3 },
   ...
```
